page.layout: One page of text, one column, centred headings. Top: running head and page number. Then the French poem (IX. GAL.), a centred heading LAT., and the Latin poem in italics. Last line at the right is the catchword. No margin notes.

main_text.head: IX. GAL.
main_text.p: QUAND on arrestera la course coustumiere Du grand courrier des Cieux,qui porte la lumiere:

Quand on arrestera l'an, qui roule tousiours Sur un char attellé de mois,d'heures,de jours: Quand onarrestera l'armee vagabonde, Qui va courant la nuict par le vuide des cieux, Descochant contre nous les longs traits de ses yeux: Lors on arrestera l'inconstance du Monde.
main_text.head: LAT.

p.i: QUUM solis olim videris aureos Currus nitenti lumine subditum Orbem foventes,non sueto More suos cohibere cursus:
Et quum rotatum pergere tardius Anni fugacis videris impetum, Quem mensium motus recurrens, Quemq; dies rapiunt & horæ:
Et quum solutis sydera legibus, Cursu per almi quæ properant vago Conuexa cæli nocte tota Agmine constiterint quieto: Quæ sorte mundi tam variabili Terras per omnes, omnia fluctuant Incerta,

page.notes: Faint show-through of text from the reverse page is visible on the right side and is omitted. Printed spellings kept as they stand (for example "onarrestera", "Cieux,qui"). The heading "IX. GAL." is set as a level 2 part, as it is a poem title. The catchword "Incerta," sits at the right below the last line.
